answer.summary: The API Types Check failed because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. The PR adds keep_findings to the Java inputs, but the regenerated types show it missing from the committed file, so the job fails deterministically on this commit. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result. A retry will fail the same way.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
